tagline: Delivering comprehensive risk management, insurance and consulting services worldwide.
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted operating income (EBITDAC) reflects the core performance of the brokerage business model, significantly impacted by the integration of strategic acquisitions such as AssuredPartners, a major driver of structural growth.
company_description: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co., together with its subsidiaries, provides insurance and reinsurance brokerage, consulting, and third-party property/casualty claims settlement and administration services to entities and individuals worldwide. The company operates in Brokerage and Risk Management segments. Its Brokerage segment offers retail and wholesale insurance and reinsurance brokerage services; assists retail brokers and other non-affiliated brokers in the placement of specialized and hard-to-place insurance; and acts as a brokerage wholesaler, managing general agent, and managing general underwriter for distributing specialized insurance coverages to underwriting enterprises. This segment performs activities, including marketing, underwriting, issuing policies, collecting premiums, appointing and supervising other agents, paying claims, and negotiating reinsurance; and offers services in the areas of insurance and reinsurance placement, risk of loss management, and management of employer sponsored benefit programs. kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDAC Margin
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, amortization, and acquisition costs, divided by revenue.
kpis.description: The adjusted EBITDAC margin in the brokerage segment reaches 36.5% in 2025, an increase of 145 basis points, supported by the integration of AssuredPartners and Woodruff Sawyer.
kpis.signal: Margin expanding strongly due to acquisition synergies.

kpis.name: Brokerage Segment Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated from insurance and reinsurance brokerage services.
kpis.description: Brokerage segment revenues reach $12.2 billion in 2025, up 23%, driven by acquisitions and 6% organic growth.
kpis.signal: Strong organic and external growth in core operations.

kpis.name: Organic Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding the effects of acquisitions and foreign exchange.
kpis.description: Combined organic growth in the brokerage and risk management segments amounts to 6% in 2025, indicating strong business model resilience.

kpis.name: Risk Management Segment Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues from claims management, claims administration, and loss control services.
kpis.description: The risk management segment reports $1.6 billion in revenues in 2025, up 9%, with 6% organic growth.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in a specialized segment.

kpis.name: Total Adjusted EBITDAC
kpis.explanation: Adjusted profitability metric excluding non-recurring charges related to acquisitions.
kpis.description: Total adjusted EBITDAC reaches $4.5 billion in 2025, up 27%, reflecting the effectiveness of post-acquisition synergies.
kpis.signal: Significant profitability improvement following acquisition integration.

kpis.name: Market Capitalization
kpis.explanation: Total market value of outstanding shares.
kpis.description: AJG's market capitalization reaches approximately $67 billion as of December 31, 2025, reflecting its position as the world's third-largest insurance broker.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: AJG has approximately 10,900 employees following the acquisition of AssuredPartners, strengthening its presence in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Ireland.
kpis.signal: Significant scale following the AssuredPartners acquisition.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $1.721 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2019).

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.7 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.667 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 44.6% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Acquisition Impact on Revenues
kpis.explanation: Contribution of recent acquisitions to revenue growth.
kpis.description: The acquisitions of AssuredPartners ($13.8 billion) and Woodruff Sawyer ($1.2 billion) were major catalysts. The 23% revenue growth in the brokerage segment breaks down into +17% from acquisitions and +6% organic.

kpis.name: After-Tax Losses on Clean Energy Investments
kpis.explanation: Net after-tax losses related to clean energy investments.
kpis.description: Clean energy investments generated an after-tax loss of $5 million in 2025, a stable amount compared to 2024, and expected in 2026.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Economic and Geopolitical Risk
risks.summary: Global economic and geopolitical events could significantly reduce brokerage revenues and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate fluctuations, inflation, geo-economic fragmentation, armed conflicts (Ukraine, Middle East), and political instabilities directly impact insurers' risk appetite and clients' investment decisions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.summary: The company's reputation is essential to its success, and any damage could have serious consequences on client relationships.
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is a key asset for attracting and retaining clients. Any reputational damage could materially impact new client acquisition and existing client retention. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risk
risks.summary: Acquisitions are a key element of the growth strategy, but carry significant integration and synergy realization risks.
risks.score_rationale: AJG acquired AssuredPartners ($13.8 billion) and Woodruff Sawyer ($1.2 billion) in 2025. The risk of failing to achieve expected synergies, losing key talent, or encountering technological integration issues could affect growth. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.summary: Cybersecurity is an increasing risk, particularly given the sensitivity of the data managed.
risks.score_rationale: AJG handles clients' confidential information (insurance data, personal data). A cybersecurity breach could result in financial losses, legal liabilities, and reputational damage. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.summary: Regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions remains an ongoing operational challenge.
risks.score_rationale: Insurance brokers operate in a complex and evolving regulatory environment. Regulatory changes could increase compliance costs and limit business models. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology and AI Risk
risks.summary: Technological transformation and AI adoption are critical to maintaining competitiveness and operational efficiencies.
risks.score_rationale: The inability to effectively apply technology, data analytics, and AI to create customer value or improve internal controls could affect competitiveness. AJG is also exposed to risks specific to AI. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.summary: Persistent competition in the sector could affect organic growth and margin levels.
risks.score_rationale: The insurance brokerage market is competitive. New entrants, disruptive technology, or consolidation among competitors could affect market share and margins. (default score, to be refined)
